name: Design Service Level Objectives
summary: Design service objectives from user journeys, measurable indicators, error budgets, and response policy.
description: Design or audit service-level indicators, objectives, error budgets, windows, alerts, and operating policy around critical user journeys. Use when a team needs a reliability target that can guide engineering and incident decisions.
risk_reason: This skill designs service objectives from user journeys, measurable indicators, error budgets, and response policy; it does not create paging alerts or release blocks without owner approval.
refuses: It does not copy an arbitrary availability percentage or hide exclusions to meet it.
It does not equate component health with end-user success without evidence.
It does not create paging alerts or release blocks without owner approval.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs service objectives from user journeys, measurable indicators, error budgets, and response policy, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
